div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Note—The individuals identified below were principal participants in the events covered in this volume. Other officials and individuals not included in the list are identified in footnotes to the text at appropriate places. In general, persons attending but not participating in meetings, and those mentioned only in passing have not been identified. Identifications are limited to circumstances and positions under reference in this volume. All titles and positions are North American unless otherwise indicated. Wherever possible dates of tenure and the spelling of names follow the information provided in official publications of the countries concerned.
